menu.hintgame.title: How to play
menu.hintgame.content:
Sort all eight rows from Ace to King, with one suit in each row. There are two copies of every card.

1. Drag a card into an empty space, or tap a card and then tap a space.

2. Only an Ace can fill a space in the first column.

3. In any other column, the card must be the next rank in the same suit as the card on its left. For example, place the 5 of hearts after the 4 of hearts.

4. A space after a King cannot be filled. Cards already in order from an Ace at the start of a row are locked.

Green means a valid move; red means an invalid move. Use Undo to take back a move, or Restart to try the same deal again.
